THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
MODERN PROPORTION
047
64 / Forest Tweed
Fur-Trim Mini
Full-length look with long copper-red waves: a cropped dark olive
tweed jacket over a white ruched halter top, a matching tweed
mini skirt with a deep brown faux-fur hem, tall brown western
boots and a pink heart-zip shoulder bag.
65 / Porcelain Suit
Corset Blazer
A cream tailored blazer with a plunging V neckline,
corset-seamed bodice and nipped waist over a matching mini
skirt, finished with pearl-beaded hoop earrings. Sleek straight
brown hair in a minimal pale studio.
